mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the same month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < previous month - 10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes despite the demand weakness proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase above 0.4 percentage points from the previous month, sustained for two consecutive months, signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.4pp for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of at least 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces input demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for three consecutive months by at least 0.5% each month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decrease of at least 0.25 percentage points in FEDFUNDS and a concurrent increase of at least 0.5% in the CPIAUCSL index signals a mismatch between monetary tightening and persistent inflation, which erodes real purchasing power and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such co-occurrence events.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase of at least 2% in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth YoY) combined with a stable or rising HOUST series over the same period signals strengthening housing demand and consumer purchasing power, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS YoY growth > 2% AND HOUST >= previous month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in more than 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase (PAYEMS) of at least 50,000 persons for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises by at least 50,000 persons for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 70% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly real retail sales proxy (RSAFS) increase of at least 1.5% from the previous month, sustained for two consecutive months, indicates strengthening consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 1.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in more than 50% of triggered episodes.
